folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B214, 2026-11-04
folds.body: This full plan was reviewed as a proposed local cohort/clock contract. Distinct receipts on exact native keys preserve different ages even for equal-name food; inventory count stays quantity authority. Stillness age, accumulated fractional debt, orderly release fee and lapse conversion are different values and transitions. The four-minute counterexample, fee boundary, uneven-step comparison, partial withdrawal/redeposit and failed durable nativePatch are planned discriminating checks, not recorded passing evidence. Optional missing remainder/priorAge means legacy zero or retained history, without reconstructing unrecorded aging. Do not promote this hearthShelf encoding to a universal lot schema or derive wall elapsed from it (AD32/AD36). Later W3 process-custody/source contracts need their own actual consumer evidence.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B214, 2026-11-04
folds.body: The complete adapter plan separates historical source-calendar projection from advancing time or claiming source readiness. Coordinate, active instance, profile, revision and local units come from the actual validated owner; a display label or home/root clock is not substitute evidence. An explicit past coordinate cannot exceed retained elapsed. Unknown season remains unknown, and a strict W5 schema must select compatible fields rather than accepting new payload fields implicitly. MoL/Paradise visitors and HP opening-at/root conventions stay distinct. These are proposed export/validation and planned tests, not verified current exports or W5 integration (AD32/AD36/AD51). A concrete supported caller justifies extending the adapter; no all-world clock schema is required first.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B214, 2026-11-04
folds.body: Retain this finite household palette as a source-informed proposal. A deterministic authored birth/marriage/death/news schedule across calendar years differs from autonomous friendship generation, per-minute work and general browser-closed social catch-up. B211’s full relationship audit specifically corrects the inference that the yearly news tick creates ties. Existing social/clock owners should receive a selected future mechanism, with observer delivery and causal consequences kept distinct. The local32-person/16-news limits describe a bounded initial fixture, not universal population or friend caps; family expansion and other worlds remain reachable (AD22/AD32). Proposed large-versus-yearly catch-up and import checks are not passing results established by this document or this review.
